verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs describe official Python and TypeScript SDKs alongside REST (skyvern-docs-1, skyvern-docs-30). They name 'the Skyvern SDK' driving a cloud Chromium over CDP with Playwright (skyvern-docs-5) and document concrete methods such as page.extract(prompt, schema) and page.agent.run_task (skyvern-docs-4, skyvern-docs-34, skyvern-docs-19). An OpenAPI spec backs the REST surface (skyvern-supp-openapi-document). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, and evidence of SDK package installation, versioning and full reference coverage.
